content_kind.description: What the invented bytes look like. Only applies when fsagen invents them.

crtime.description: Creation (birth) time. Windows only; elsewhere a pre-flight error unless --on-unsupported=skip.

ctime.description: Metadata change time. Windows on NTFS or ReFS only; elsewhere a pre-flight error unless --on-unsupported=skip.

id.description: Names what this action creates or renames, for later ref/refs.

missing_ok.description: delete: a missing path is a recorded no-op.

ref.description: Instead of path: the one live path created under this id.

refs.description: Instead of path: every live path created under this id.

method.description: store (the default) is byte-identical on every toolchain; deflate is not.

Condition.description: A step condition tests the iteration index; an action condition tests the batch index.

Duration.description: Go duration with day (d) and week (w) units, for example 15m, 2h, 2d6h.

delete_lines.description: A 1-based inclusive line or range of lines, for example 40-60.

data.description: The event's data values by name.

event_id.description: The event's id. Built in, with Windows' own provider, channel and data: 1102, 4624, 4688, 7045.

target.description: The Windows path the link points at, on a drive letter: C:\Users\Public\tool.exe.

Mitre.description: MITRE technique IDs (T1234 or T1234.001) the action exhibits. Annotation only: it changes no byte written. The shape is checked, not the MITRE catalogue.

imports.description: Imported functions as dll!function, for example kernel32.dll!CreateFileW.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, or "0" for the zero stamp a reproducible build writes. Defaults to the operation time.

executable.description: The Windows path of the program that ran: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe.

harddisk_volume.description: The number N of the executable's volume, \Device\HarddiskVolumeN, which the prefetch hash is computed over; 3 by default.

data.description: Text for REG_SZ and REG_EXPAND_SZ, a number for REG_DWORD and REG_QWORD, hex bytes for REG_BINARY and REG_NONE.

Rfc3339Time.description: Timestamp in RFC 3339 format, fractional seconds allowed

cluster_size.description: The cluster size the slack is planned for; 4096 by default. On a live volume it must be the volume's own.

mitre.description: MITRE technique IDs every action in the step exhibits, on top of its own.

description: Documents fsagen playbook input files. fsagen validates input itself; this schema mirrors those rules for editors.

start.description: RFC 3339 start of the scenario, or "now" for a run that cannot be reproduced.

subsecond_jitter.description: Add a seeded fraction of a second to every time derived from the schedule, never to an explicit one.

title: FSAGen Playbook Schema
